headline: Conservationists Complete Largest Cheetah Relocation Ever
meta_description: Conservationists successfully relocated 16 cheetahs nearly 1,000 miles to Mozambique in a record-breaking operation completed in 53 hours despite torrential ra…
summary_short: In a historic conservation milestone, 16 cheetahs were moved nearly 1,000 miles to Mozambique in just 53 hours—the largest relocation of its kind ever attempted.
body:
Conservationists have completed the largest cheetah relocation ever attempted, moving 16 of the endangered cats nearly 1,000 miles to Mozambique. The operation unfolded over 53 grueling hours, testing the limits of what wildlife experts believed possible.

What made this feat especially remarkable was the challenge posed by unexpected torrential rain, which forced the team to alter their route at the last minute. Working under these harrowing conditions, conservationists persevered to ensure all 16 cheetahs reached their destination safely. The successful relocation represents a significant moment for cheetah conservation efforts, demonstrating both the dedication of wildlife professionals and the possibility of large-scale species protection even when nature presents sudden obstacles.
quick_facts: Route changed due to torrential rain
